Touchscreen Installation

SDANA Natural Hazards Installation

Helps visitors of the Valais natural hazards service (SDANA) understand avalanches, floods, storms and rockfall, and know how to react when one happens. On a very large touchscreen at the SDANA offices, each hazard unfolds in illustrated scenes, in several languages: what it is, how it forms, what to do.

Features

  • Built for a large public touchscreen display
  • Covers multiple natural hazards and risk scenarios
  • Explains hazard mechanisms with guided visual content
  • Behaviour and safety guidance for visitors
  • Multi-language navigation and content
